entries.regs_verbatim: No Fishing within 100 m downstream of the falls situated approximately 4.5 km upstream of Wakeman River

issues.problem: Regs close only 'within 100 m downstream of the falls' — a narrow band — but the rule uses op:upstream_of on the single split wahpeeto_creek__within_100_m_downstream. Elsewhere in this same batch (index 222, Bear Creek) op:upstream_of on a split is used to mean 'everything from that split toward the source', which here would sweep in the falls and everything above them, including the two upstream lakes (wahpeeto_creek__lake_329507897, wahpeeto_creek__lake_329508140) that the regs never mention.
issues.fix: Verify the split's actual position/semantics; if it marks the point 100 m below the falls, the closure should be bounded on both ends (a 'between' extent spanning falls-to-100m-downstream), not an open-ended upstream_of that also closes the lakes above the falls.
